masthead.title: Disaster Relief Fund
masthead.subtitle: Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund and Prime Minister's Relief Fund

deposit.title: Deposit accounts
deposit.subtitle: Scan the QR with any mobile banking or wallet app, or transfer to the account number shown.
deposit.verifyNotice: Before you confirm payment, your banking app must display the recipient name PM DISASTER RELIEF FUND or PM RELIEF FUND. If it shows any other name, stop and do not send.
deposit.warnNotice: These eight accounts are the only official channels. The Government of Nepal is not collecting relief funds through any other account, QR code, payment link or crowdfunding page.
deposit.internationalSubtitle: SWIFT transfers, correspondent bank details and foreign-currency instructions.

institutional.title: Institutional contributions
institutional.subtitle: Contributions above Rs {{value, number}} lakh, published with consent.

footer.methodology: Account balances are read directly from each participating bank over a read-only interface and refreshed every 15 minutes. No figure on this page is entered by hand. Disbursement data is published from the fund's transaction ledger.
footer.office: Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers
